_comment: Input for bulk-fix.php. Each entry resolves one fixable error group (entity + field) for every failing row at once, writing swag_migration_fix rows via the Sync API. Inspect swag_migration_logging to see which entity/field pairs are failing, then describe the value each should get.

fixes._note: address-less customers get the placeholder customer's address (the tool's own remedy)

SEO URLs from Chinese store views: give each the right language per store (works around the script-subtag locale bug; see [LINK: article] for the full failure analysis). storeIds are the source store_id values for those views.
empty legacy names and damaged emails get safe placeholders
